title: My Claude Code Course Comes With Free Lifetime Community
description:
I built a Claude Code course that walks you through every tool you need from scratch. The setup, building your first website, your own personal life dashboard, all of it.

Here is the unusual part. I'm running Hormozi-style price testing on the course. Every few buyers, the price goes up. I started low because I genuinely didn't know what to charge.

Anyone who buys at the current price also gets free lifetime access to my paid community. Most communities charge monthly. Mine is included forever if you grab the course now.

People keep telling me it has been life-changing, which feels weird to say about a course. But that is what they tell me.

#claudecode #aicoding
